game_concept: A puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Stump Court, a court around a giant stump: the wood elf archer must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the herb garden.
theme: Mystic Forest – Stump Court: a court around a giant stump
core_gameplay_loop: In Stump Court, repeat each round: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the herb garden. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the pattern_rows value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the herb garden using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The herb garden reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the herb garden is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Pattern Painter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pattern Painter' (Week 5 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Stump Court'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
